verdict.rationale: Lambda's REST API and cloud-init support programmatic, scriptable instance management, and 1-Click Clusters/Managed Slurm/MK8s let users provision and schedule work across many GPUs/nodes at once (e.g., 16-512 GPU clusters, Slurm job scheduling across nodes). However, there's no explicit documentation of batch/bulk API endpoints (e.g., creating or terminating many discrete instances in a single call) — the evidence shows scale-out cluster provisioning and job scheduling, not general bulk-item operations. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API operations (e.g., batch launch/terminate many arbitrary resources in one call), independent validation of bulk workflows at scale.
